name: Manisha Chauhan
quote: Our first experience at Gharelu Bake was worth the hype. Amazing staff, super amazing food and the most delectable cakes.

name: Kashish Sundwal
quote: The Tiramisu and Oreo Cheesecake were absolutely amazing! Both desserts literally melted in my mouth. The flavors were rich and perfectly balanced.

name: Divyam Dilaik
quote: If you're hunting for the best bakery in the Zirakpur-Chandigarh area, look no further. Don't miss this place! 11/10 rating.
